entries.title: Isaiah 12:1
segments: ¶And in that day you will say: "O LORD, I will praise You; Though You were angry with me, Your anger is turned away, and You comfort me.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:2
segments: Behold, God [is] my salvation, I will trust and not be afraid; 'For YAH, the LORD, [is] my strength and song; He also has become my salvation.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 12:3
segments: Therefore with joy you will draw water From the wells of salvation.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:4
segments: ¶And in that day you will say: "Praise the LORD, call upon His name; Declare His deeds among the peoples, Make mention that His name is exalted.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:5
segments: Sing to the LORD, For He has done excellent things; This [is] known in all the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:6
segments: Cry out and shout, O inhabitant of Zion, For great [is] the Holy One of Israel in your midst!"
